description: A bright office meeting room: a glass wall onto an open-plan office where coworkers walk past, a wall screen with a live chart, a ticking clock, coral pendant lights and a plant. Everyone sits at a long meeting table: two side-on at its ends (marks left and right, facing each other) and one at the back facing the camera (mark center), seen from the chest up behind the table. The relatable three-person channel's work set.
